conclusion.statement: glTF 2.1 and GLB container version 3 are announced and under active development. No released or ratified glTF 2.1 specification and no official GLB v3 conformance assets were found. The byte layout may still change.

contradicted_secondary_claim: At least one third-party news article describes glTF 2.1 as officially released in June 2026. The Khronos registry and the open tracking issue contradict this; the June 2026 Khronos post announces plans.

draft_layout_read.alignment: Each chunk starts on an 8-byte boundary. Padding after a chunk is outside chunkLength, is not read and should be zero. The file length need not be a multiple of any number.
draft_layout_read.buffers: buffer.chunk references a chunk by index; buffer 0 without chunk and uri implicitly uses a BIN chunk at index 1 directly after a JSON chunk at index 0; the chunk must be at least as long as the buffer.
draft_layout_read.chunk_encoding: 0 means plain. Clients must refuse chunks with unknown encoding. The draft defines no other value.
draft_layout_read.chunk_header: uint32 chunkType, uint32 chunkEncoding, uint64 chunkLength (most significant bit must be 0)
draft_layout_read.chunk_types: JSON 0x4E4F534A and BIN 0x004E4942; other types may appear. The first JSON chunk is the glTF JSON; chunks may precede it.
draft_layout_read.file_header: uint32 magic 0x46546C67, uint32 version 3, uint64 length (most significant bit must be 0)
draft_layout_read.json_integers: Integer properties may be written as decimals with a zero fraction or in exponent notation (100, 100.0, 1e2); the sandbox accepts these and refuses a non-zero fraction.
sandbox_stricter_than_draft: A nonzero chunkEncoding on any chunk refuses the whole file.
Only asset versions 2.0 and 2.1 are inspected; other versions are refused.
Duplicate JSON object keys are refused (the draft says keys should be unique and that the last value should win).
A buffer that defines both chunk and uri is refused; a files entry needs exactly one of uri and bufferView.
Integer values above 2^53 are refused (the draft says such buffers should not be used).
Trailing bytes after the last chunk are accepted only as padding up to the next 8-byte boundary.
Every resource budget reported under limits in a receipt is a refusal reason; the draft defines no such upper bounds.

extension_registry.note: The blog post says the exact syntax for the promoted functionality 'will be defined as the specification develops'. The sandbox reports names only and decodes no extension payload.

observations.finding: The merged draft GLB v3 reader and its fixture writer pad and advance chunks to 4-byte boundaries inside chunkLength. The Khronos draft text at the pinned commit requires 8-byte aligned chunk starts with padding outside chunkLength. Files from both layouts agree only when every padded chunk length is a multiple of eight.
Shown as a draft pull request, not merged.

Not retrieved: the download host path was not reachable from this session. The archive is therefore not SHA-pinned here. One layout table printed in the issue comment is reconstructed as a test vector; its six filler bytes are not published.

Open; shows 0 of 14 sub-issues completed; milestone 2.1 without due date. Text: 'The specification is under active development. Feature explainers are the current stable reference; schema and normative text to follow.'
